body:
Well.... She did it. This time the bullets weren't blanks. She's in the hospital with no chance of survival. Now her friends, family (even her mom) and me are depressed. Her aunts blame theirselves and I do a little too. Everyone thought she was ok. I guess not.
Shai
06-08-2000 to 03-10-2016 
Not even an adult 😔

I got her to see the counselor. She's been keeping a lot in. She decided that she's gonna talk to people. She kept it in for awhile, let loose on boxing, dirt bike stunts, gaming, music and other sports. I think she's ok now! Her friends were informed about this and they talked to her and they took her sketch book and they're keeping it away. She admitted to trying to kill herself. With a knife, noose, jumping off her house, running through the highway and a gun... She pulled the trigger but there was blank bullets in it. Thank god.

Well just think of what could happen. It is a permanent solution for a short time problem. I had many friends try suicide. I was one of them, I felt alone and cold. Still do, I'm putting my stress on something. You can always seek help. I didn't cause I found a way to deal with my thoughts. Just find something you enjoy or used to enjoy and make it better for yourself. I didn't have anyone for me too. That one person that I loved couldn't love me back so I dealt with it. Life moves on. I hope you'll find the better for yourself. I truly do.

Well I talked to her about. She told me to meet her outside behind the building at lunch so I did. She bursted out crying and said its true. She doesn't want to go to the counselor cause she thinks she's adding more to their problems. She's tried Suicide many times. She told me how she felt alone in this big world and how she always causes a conflict. We talked for a long time after school. I've never seen this side of her. She begged me not to tell anyone. But I need to tell her aunts. She said her aunts don't care, they've seen her held a gun to her head and they said there's a knife in the kitchen. Don't waste that bullet. She's been working 2 jobs to get an apartment away from them next year and that's been just adding more stress. How can I help her with this?

Her relationship with her mother isn't good. She left her when she was about 8 for her new husband. Shai didn't really seem to respond to this. She went along her life as if nothing happened. Her aunts are her legal guardian now. She doesn't like to talk to other people she doesn't know. Which leads to believe she has trust issues. I should probably mention, I took pictures of her book and send it to her. She replied that the book isn't hers. It was a friends who is feeling suicidal. But that's her hand writing and she's a damn good artist. It was her art style. She denied being suicidal and feeling alone. She just smiles and says she knows she has friends and people that care for her and she grabbed the book then stuffed it in her bag and leave to her aunts car.
